items: all-in-one battery with built-in inverter (120/240 V home backup unit)
why: The shopper asked for an all-in-one product, and ChatGPT ranked single products (Powerwall 3, DELTA Pro Ultra, aPower 2); its only caveat was that some picks use separate boxes, not that the shopper must add a second item. The fact that decides the pick is 120/240 V split-phase output with enough continuous kW and expandable kWh, so the page should compare all-in-one units such as Anker SOLIX E10 or F3800 Plus, BLUETTI Apex 300, OSCAL PowerMax 6000 and Nature's Generator L6000, and recommend one, rather than build a Sun Gold Power inverter-and-rack-battery kit.
